items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: Would that be the one in the band with Paula Barber and Albert Nicholas?

ctx.x: He really, it was remarkable how he came back to himself. I never think that he was that. He thought he was a young boy in the caucus. Strange. That's why I keep saying this is such a good picture of him because I can picture him, you know, in that casket and how his features came back so perfectly. Yes. Just like he is there. I have to laugh at him because he did everything. He played in all kinds of people. Now here he is in a soldier's uniform. He got in anything. He used to wear some beautiful white and gold…
Would that be the one in the band with Paula Barber and Albert Nicholas? I showed you, yes.
